title: Training manifest — §5 candidate-group ranking, whole-match split, architecture comparison

objective.name: within-frame learning-to-rank
objective.formula: L = (1/G) * Σ_frames [ noRegression ? 0 : 1/2 Σ_k (out_pos,k − y_pos,k)²  +  λ · (1/|neg|) Σ_neg −log σ(s_pos − s_neg) ]
objective.score: s = heldGain − lossRisk (exactly the runtime policy score)
objective.note: Fixes the §3 root cause: the positive (observed+executed) candidate in each planning frame must be scored ABOVE the counterfactual candidates, so the cross-candidate score spread becomes discriminative instead of near-constant.

dataset.split: whole-match, sideOf(matchId, 21): 854 train groups / 3483 val groups (4337 total, 372 dropped no-positive)

arms.note: M2 — reference full-batch ranking model on combined data

arms.optimizer: mini-batch SGD, bag 48, shuffled, LCG seed 1337 (train-v5rank-arch.cjs)
mini-batch SGD, bag 48, shuffled, LCG seed 1337 (train-v5rank-arch.cjs)
arms.note: Larger hidden layer; best in the prior regression run but here loses the ranking objective to arch-20 and is runtime-incompatible (validate() locks 32x20x2 / 702).

selection.rationale: On the SAME held-out val groups: arch-20 ties M2 on valRankLoss (0.854404) but yields 2.4x the cross-candidate score spread (0.5031 vs 0.2121) and 6x the offline decision departure rate (0.1796 vs 0.029). arch-20 also beats arch-40 on valRankLoss (0.854404 < 0.910058) and decisionRate (0.1796 > 0.109). arch-20 is the only runtime-compatible (702 / 32x20x2-tanh) winner.

conclusions.objective: ranking-only (noRegression) is the correct objective for a control ranker; regression+ranking adds no decision value and inflates train loss.
conclusions.architecture: 32x20x2 > 32x40x2 on the ranking objective and offline decision metrics. 32x40x2 remains a candidate for a future versioned kernel (it is best offline in the prior regression line) but is NOT runtime-compatible today.
conclusions.optimizer: mini-batch SGD (bag 48) > full-batch GD for the ranking objective: at equal valRankLoss it finds a far more discriminative solution (higher cross-std, higher decisionRate). No blind epoch increase was used (all combined arms held at epoch 400).
